title: wolfSSL X.509 date buffer overflow in wolfSSL_X509_notAfter / wolfSSL_X509_notBefore
expected_vulnerable_behavior: On wolfSSL v5.9.0-stable with ASan/UBSan, an API-level harness using a crafted WOLFSSL_ASN1_TIME object with length 255 triggers AddressSanitizer heap-buffer-overflow with WRITE of size 255 through both wolfSSL_X509_notAfter and wolfSSL_X509_notBefore paths.
expected_fixed_behavior: wolfSSL v5.9.1-stable rejects the crafted WOLFSSL_ASN1_TIME object with length 255 without ASan heap-buffer-overflow, WRITE of size 255 crash, or abort. The harness exits with code 1 because the oversized date length is rejected.
expected_current_behavior: Current wolfSSL v5.9.1-stable-1373-g8fca95ce6 rejects the crafted WOLFSSL_ASN1_TIME object with length 255 in both notAfter and notBefore paths without ASan heap-buffer-overflow, WRITE of size 255 crash, or abort. The harness exits with code 1 because the oversized date length is rejected.
crash_signal: ASan heap-buffer-overflow; WRITE of size 255; memcpy; notAfter exit code 134; notBefore exit code 134.
migration_value: High. X.509 date parsing behavior can be compared across wolfSSL, OpenSSL, and mbedTLS date/time parsing APIs.
notes: API-level strict reproduction succeeded on wolfSSL v5.9.0-stable commit 922d04b3568c6428a9fb905ddee3ef5a68db3108 using a crafted WOLFSSL_ASN1_TIME object following PR 10071's official test pattern. Both notAfter and notBefore paths triggered ASan heap-buffer-overflow with WRITE of size 255. Fixed release candidate verified: wolfSSL v5.9.1-stable commit 1d363f3adceba9d1478230ede476a37b0dcdef24 rejects the oversized ASN1_TIME length in both notAfter and notBefore paths without sanitizer crash evidence. Current wolfSSL v5.9.1-stable-1373-g8fca95ce6 commit 8fca95ce651d6e370d91f5598786de4bc66aa2c2 was tested with the same API-level X.509 date harness. Both notAfter and notBefore paths safely rejected the oversized ASN1_TIME length without sanitizer crash evidence.
